title: Platform config
subtitle: Live-tunable settings. Changes apply within seconds — no redeploy.
consulOfflineHint: The config store (Consul) isn't reachable, so changes can't be saved. Set CONSUL_ENABLED + the Consul host, then reload.
serviceFeeRateHint: Platform fee as a fraction of order total. 0.02 = 2%.
bogEnvHint: Flips the BOG payment host. Store credentials must match the selected environment.
publicBaseUrlHint: Origin BOG redirects/calls back to. Blank derives from the request.
